description: Tidal current predictions for a CO-OPS current station: max flood and ebb speeds, slack times, and mean flood and ebb bearings. For observed NDBC ocean-current measurements by depth, use noaa_marine_get_current_profile. MAX_SLACK (default, up to 365 days) returns peak and slack events for passage planning. 6min (up to 31 days) returns a continuous curve for a harmonic bin. A subordinate bin returns max/slack events with a notice and empty predictions. Select a depth bin from bins[] on a noaa_marine_find_stations current row, or let CO-OPS choose its default. The response echoes the answered bin and depth. When CO-OPS returns a statement about weak and variable currents, the notice carries its wording and the requested series is empty. Both intervals page the returned series by row count from offset, up to limit. A partial page reports rows_matched, rows_returned, and next_offset. Use noaa_marine_find_stations with types=["current"] for alphanumeric current station IDs such as ACT4176.

begin_date.description: Start date, YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "20240601" or "2024-06-01".

bin.description: Depth bin to predict for, taken from the bins[] array on a noaa_marine_find_stations current row (e.g. 15, 10 or 1 at PUG1515). Omit to let CO-OPS choose its default. A bin the station does not publish comes back as bin_unavailable naming the bins it does.

end_date.description: End date (inclusive), YYYYMMDD or YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "20240607" or "2024-06-07".

interval.description: MAX_SLACK (default, up to 365 days) returns max flood, max ebb, and slack events. 6min (up to 31 days) returns a continuous curve for harmonic bins and max/slack events for subordinate bins.

limit.description: Rows to return on this page from the series CO-OPS returned, either max/slack events or 6-minute rows. Default 50; a larger value returns at most 1,000 and says so.

offset.description: Row offset into the returned series, whether max/slack events or a 6-minute curve. 0 (default) starts at the first row; pass next_offset from a previous call to continue. An offset past the last row returns an empty page.

station_id.description: CO-OPS current station ID (alphanumeric, e.g. "ACT4176"). Obtain from noaa_marine_find_stations with types=["current"].

time_zone.description: Time zone for returned timestamps. lst_ldt = local standard/daylight time (default); gmt = UTC; lst = local standard time year-round.

units.description: Unit system: english = knots for speed and feet for the echoed depth; metric = cm/s for speed (not m/s) and meters for the echoed depth.

name: noaa_marine_get_currents

bin.description: Depth bin CO-OPS answered with — the requested bin or the default it selected. Null when CO-OPS returned no prediction rows.

depth.description: Depth of the returned bin, in the requested units: feet under english, meters under metric. Distinct from the bins[].depth on a noaa_marine_find_stations row, which the catalog always publishes in feet. Null when CO-OPS publishes no depth for the bin, or when the response carried no prediction rows.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `station_not_found`: CO-OPS rejected the station ID as unknown or invalid — current stations require alphanumeric IDs. `invalid_date_range`: begin_date or end_date is not a real calendar date, or the range starts after it ends. `date_range_exceeded`: The request exceeds the CO-OPS date span limit for the selected interval. `no_predictions`: Station exists but CO-OPS returned no current-prediction data for the requested date range. `predictions_unavailable`: The station is in the current-predictions catalog, but CO-OPS publishes no current predictions for it at any date. `bin_unavailable`: CO-OPS rejected the requested bin because the station publishes no predictions at that bin. `upstream_throttled`: CO-OPS answered HTTP 403, which it returns for about two minutes while it throttles a burst of requests from one address. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

events.description: Max flood, max ebb, and slack events from offset up to limit. Present for MAX_SLACK and when CO-OPS answers 6min with events. For MAX_SLACK, empty when CO-OPS answered with a statement — read notice for its wording.

items.description: A single max flood, max ebb, or slack current event.

direction.description: The station's mean flood direction on a flood event and its mean ebb direction on an ebb event, as a true bearing in degrees (0–360). A station constant, not an instantaneous heading. Absent for slack events and wherever CO-OPS reports no mean direction.

speed.description: Peak speed as a non-negative magnitude, in the requested units. Absent when CO-OPS reports no speed for the event, which is the usual case at slack water — though a slack event can carry a small residual speed under metric units.

time.description: Event datetime in the requested time zone.

type.description: Current event type: flood (onshore/inbound flow), ebb (offshore/outbound flow), or slack (near-zero current).

next_offset.description: Offset to pass as offset on the next call, or null when this page reaches the last matched row. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

notice.description: CO-OPS's statement about the station, an explanation when 6min returns events, or page coverage and how to reach the next page. Opens with the requested and applied values when limit was clamped to its cap.

page_offset.description: Row offset this page starts at, echoed from the request. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

predictions.description: 6-minute continuous current predictions from offset up to limit. Present for 6min, and empty when CO-OPS answered with events or a statement — read notice for details.

direction.description: The station's mean flood direction on a flood row and its mean ebb direction on an ebb row, as a true bearing in degrees (0–360). A station constant, not an instantaneous heading. Null on a slack row and wherever CO-OPS reports no mean direction.

speed.description: Current speed as a non-negative magnitude, in the requested units.

time.description: Prediction datetime in the requested time zone.

type.description: Flow sense at this row, from the sign of the speed CO-OPS predicts: flood (inbound), ebb (outbound), or slack (zero). speed is a non-negative magnitude, so this is what carries which way the water is moving.

rows_matched.description: Prediction rows the requested date range matched, before the page was cut. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

rows_returned.description: Rows this page carries in the returned events or predictions series. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

station_id.description: Station ID echoed from the request — for chaining.

station_name.description: Station name as returned by CO-OPS.

truncated.description: True when this page stops short of the last matched row, so further rows remain at next_offset. False on the final page and on a page past the end. Absent when the whole matched series was returned.

units.description: Unit system these values are in: "english" (speed in knots, depth in feet) or "metric" (speed in cm/s, depth in meters).

title: Get Tidal Currents
